value.name: studies ink mark on page
value.description: Asha traces the last mark with her fingertip and examines the ink that did not transfer.
evidence: She traced the last mark slowly with her fingertip, following the small drag where the ballpoint had skipped, and then lifted her finger and looked at the ink that had not transferred.

value.name: leaves pad open while crossing room
value.description: Asha stands up, leaves the pad open on the desk, and crosses the room without closing it.
evidence: The pad stayed open on the desk when she stood, and she did not close it this time before she crossed the room.

value.name: retrieves phone and folded sheet
value.description: Asha picks up the phone and pulls the folded sheet from under the pad.
evidence: Asha picked up the phone from where she had set it face down and turned it over in her hand.
The folded sheet from the clerk's office lay under the edge of the pad, and she pulled it free

value.name: calls after-hours clerk line
value.description: Asha dials the after-hours line printed on the sheet while watching the desk clock.
evidence: and dialed the after-hours line printed at the bottom, watching the second hand on the desk clock rather than the page.

value.name: requests filing and sworn time details
value.description: When the night clerk answers, Asha asks for the exact intake stamp on Devin's corrected filing and the time the caseworker was sworn.
evidence: When the night clerk answered, she gave the docket number and asked for the exact intake stamp on Devin's corrected filing, down to the minute, and then asked him to read back the time the caseworker had been sworn that afternoon.

value.name: records timing discrepancy
value.description: Asha writes both times in the margin beside the three ticks, realizing the gap between them is smaller than she believed.
evidence: She wrote both numbers in the margin beside the three ticks and set the pen down without underlining anything, because the gap between them was smaller than she had been telling herself in the dark, and now it was on the page in someone else's hand as well as her own.

value.name: circles and links the marks
value.description: Asha circles the two numbers and loops the third tick into the same shape, binding all three marks together.
evidence: Asha picked up the pen again and drew a slow, heavy circle around the two numbers she had written in the margin, then carried the line back across the page to loop the third tick into the same shape.
